CONFIRMED.title: Confirm this order?
CONFIRMED.text: The customer agreed to the order during your call. It moves on to preparation.

SHIPPED.title: Hand the parcel to Yalidine
SHIPPED.text: Enter the Yalidine tracking number so the customer can follow the parcel.

DELIVERED.title: Mark as delivered?
DELIVERED.text: The customer received the order and paid. It now counts as revenue.

DELIVERED_HAND.title: Mark as handed over?
DELIVERED_HAND.text: You handed the order over and received the payment. It now counts as revenue.

CANCELLED.title: Cancel this order?
CANCELLED.text: The reserved stock goes back to the shop. This can't be undone.

NO_ANSWER.title: Couldn't reach the customer?
NO_ANSWER.text: The reserved stock goes back to the shop for now. You can reopen the order when you reach the customer.

NEW.title: Reopen this order?
NEW.text: The stock is reserved again. If an item has sold out in the meantime, the order can't be reopened.

RETURNED.title: Mark as returned?
RETURNED.text: The parcel came back. Stock is not restored automatically: check the bottles first, then add them back to stock yourself.

yalidine.title: Send to Yalidine?
yalidine.text: This creates the parcel at Yalidine for {code}, saves its tracking number here and marks the order as shipped.
